An explicit 20-vertex isomorphism translates all 60 state labels and both edge sets (120+60) and agrees with the complete embedded certificate. All components, edge-degree incidences, two-octagon-paths-per-hub-pair, parity and three S5 orbits, and all rootwise distance layers are asserted and independently replayed; no sampling or infinite inference.

value.rationale: The smallest legal even-cycle flip has length 6 because the Desargues graph has girth 6. The complete classification shows a genuine frozen barrier at this optimal local move length, and the least possible extension to 8 edges restores reachability between every perfect matching, an exact and natural threshold. Its octagon-only graph is not an arbitrary count: it is the one-subdivision of two parallel copies of every edge of K6, plus 24 isolates, explaining the six exceptional configurations. The S5 orbit split and all-node eccentricity four give structural and shortest-route information likely useful as a finite benchmark for constrained matching dynamics; no broader theorem is claimed or required.
